name.description: Name of the workflow created by this spec from the {@link #createWorkflow} API.

pipeline.description: The {@link ReliabilityMl.Pipeline} for which HPO should be run

template.description:
Utilize the {@link ModelTemplate for creating the {@link ReliabilityMl.Pipeline}.
If specified, it will override the given {@link #pipeline}.

nCombinations.description:
Set this field to -1 to create all possible combinations of the provided hyperparams. This corresponds to performing a
grid search on provided hyperparams.
Set this field to a fixed number in order to randomly select a subset of combinations to try out during HPO. This corresponds
to performing a random search on provided hyperparams.

datasetPreparationRun.description: Specify the {@link ReliabilityMlDatasetPreparationRun} to use to generate the features and masks in order to run HPO.

project.description: Specify the {@link ReliabilityMl.Project} for which HPO should be run.

pipelineCreationJobOptions.description:
Use this field to specify the {@link BatchJobOptions} that should be used for running the underlying
{@link ReliabilityOrchestrator.PipelineCreationJob}

trainingJobName.description:
Optional name for the {@link ReliabilityOrchestrator.TrainingJob}.
If not provided, a default name will be generated, with the following
format: `f"HPO_ModelTraining_{c3.Uuid.create()}"`.

modelConfigRun.description:
Optional {@link ModelConfigRun} to be used for {@link ReliabilityOrchestrator.TrainingJob#start} to track the
training job with hyperparameter optimization.

title:
This type can be used to configure hyperparameter optimization for a {@link ReliabilityMl.Pipeline}. The best pipeline
will be chosen based on the corresponding trained {@link ReliabilityMlModel} with the highest
{@link ReliabilityMlModel.ClassificationScore}.
name: ReliabilityOrchestrator.HpoSpec
